supersedes_placeholder.note: v1 was a NOT_TRIGGERED placeholder created before the T25 identity case work; v2 freezes the full sampling/coverage/annotation/evaluation specification while still NOT_TRIGGERED

trigger.rule: only if the winning candidate (3 seeds, selected on validation) meets ALL of:
conditions: val joint improvement over matched baseline >= +0.08 absolute
identity high-confidence false-match rate <= baseline at the frozen validation threshold
worst-group joint not worse than baseline worst-group by more than 0.05
trigger.current_state: NOT_TRIGGERED: improvement gate STOP (candidate A/B failed the pre-registered gate on 2026-11-04); no 3-seed winning candidate and no holdout capture

specification.family_rule: each family is an independent physical trajectory/pose composition; no group or frame may be split across train/val/holdout; no reuse of any existing dev/exploratory/identity frame

required_conditions.definition: target 1.5-3.0 m, green light clearly visible, expected LARGE
target >=8 m or green light <=3 px; reference may be UNAVAILABLE and must be labelled as such
target touching image edge; four-edge flags from capture geometry + visual check
map-native green-lamp MS1 alone, central target out of FOV; MS1 verified=WORLD_POSE_OR_MAP_DB
central target and MS1 both in frame with scale/lateral or same-bearing contrast; ambiguous frames use ambiguous/UNDECIDABLE, never forced positive
target physically absent or fully out of FOV and no confuser claimed as target

specification.coverage_budget_note: condition minima sum to 200; freeze the exact family mix and per-condition counts before capture; report actual denominators per condition

sampling_rule.method: per family: accepted frames sorted by integer sequence; midpoint systematic idx=floor((i+0.5)*n/k); force-include family endpoints and extreme-condition frames using capture-derived distance/truncation/green metadata only
sampling_rule.k: derived from the frozen total budget before capture; recorded in the holdout manifest

annotation_rule.labels_location: gitignored external outputs; repository keeps manifest + sha256 + statistics
annotation_rule.who_viewed: register executor, purpose, time and evidence hash for every batch
annotation_rule.qa: validate_landmark_annotations.py PASS; no merge into train/val files
annotation_rule.independence_boundary: same-agent execution is PROCESS-ISOLATED HOLDOUT, not third-party sealed; no certification claim from agent labels
annotation_rule.gt_handling: GT_UNOBSERVABLE and ambiguous frames are reported separately, not counted as positive/negative localization

evaluation_rule.precondition: model/thresholds/decoder/eval rules frozen before the single holdout evaluation
evaluation_rule.failure: report FAIL/INCOMPLETE with denominators; no reinterpretation as navigation/board/Gate acceptance

state_note: This file is the frozen specification only. When the lead triggers the holdout, the executor fills captured_run/frames/hashes into a NEW holdout freeze (v3 or later); this v2 file is never rewritten.
boundaries: internal bounded research only; distribution decision pending
